Class ProjectSecurity

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.config.ProjectSecurity
@Component("ProjectSecurity") public class ProjectSecurity extends Object
ProjectSecurity provides methods to check permissions for managing projects and project collaborators. Mirrors the shape of CourseSecurity in proj-scaffold: hasManagePermissions allows the owner, any collaborator, or an admin (read access to a project's details and its collaborator list); hasOwnerPermissions is restricted to the owner (or an admin) for mutating the project itself or its collaborator list.

Note that for a method with a projectId, you still need to verify in each method whether the project exists or not. These annotations will only check whether or not the particular user has access to a particular project.
